segments.dry: Reviewers with dry to very dry skin describe disappearance of dry patches, flaking and cracked areas after regular nighttime use, especially in winter.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who identify as sensitive-skinned generally report no new irritation or breakouts, though one reports hives and blistering rash and another reports burning when used on damaged skin.
segments.combination: One reviewer with combination, acne-prone skin reports the serum helped acne and left skin smooth and moisturized.
segments.mature: A reviewer over 50 uses it as a nighttime slugging product instead of Vaseline, and another reports temporary softening of vertical lip lines with little effect on forehead or neck wrinkles.
segments.oily: One reviewer with oily, sensitive skin reports it hydrates without residue or irritation.

concerns.aging: One reviewer reports a temporary reduction in vertical lip lines but no visible change to eye, forehead or neck wrinkles.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe reversal of dryness, flaking and cracked skin on face, hands, feet and lips, often within one to a few days of nightly use; one reviewer with only mildly dry skin found it too heavy and greasy for her needs.
concerns.redness: Reviewers using it on eczema and rash-prone skin report reduced redness and calmer skin, with one describing full clearing of redness and flaky spots around the eyes.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers credit the product with repairing a damaged or over-exfoliated skin barrier, including recovery from retinoid or benzoyl peroxide irritation, within one to a few days.
concerns.spots: One reviewer used it under makeup on creasing, peeling spots with good results; no other spot-specific effects are described.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are mixed: several say it never causes breakouts and one used it to help a family member's acne, while one reviewer describes severe whiteheads and clogged pores after first use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with oily skin reports hydration without added residue or shine; others simply note the product itself feels greasy on application.

extraits.texte: This is the worst skin product I have ever used. And I feel very disappointed because I usually love CeraVe products. I've been using the foam cleanser for years. But this stuff gave me the worst acne of my life. It seems like every ingredient is designed to clog your pores. I am not the type of person that is prone to acne breakouts or pimples. But the day after using this stuff for the first time, every single pore in my forehead was clogged with whiteheads. It's an extremely GREASY formula. You may as well slather Crisco all over your face!
I haven't noticed any real differences with my skin. However, my skin is very sensitive and this product didn't make me break out or cause any rashes, so I'll keep using it.

I live in the dry desert, have sensitive skin and eczema. I started using a retinoid to help my pores and it gave me the most painful flare up I've ever had, cracking and peeling my skin all over my face to the point of tears and embarrased to go to work. This product instantly helped and has allowed me to complete my skincare routine! I feel great and my skin is glowing. So happy to find this!

This product is amazing, I noticed a huge difference in my skin after about two weeks of using CeraVe products. I'm 43 years old with combination acne prone skin. This product helped my acne and gave my skin a very moisturized and smooth appearance, just wish there was a way to use all of the product in the tube. There is no way to take the lid off to use all of the serum and it is kind of pricy.

I love cerave products and have been using them for years. This cream is lightweight, non drying, and leaves my skin with a silky smooth texture. I have very oily sensitive skin, and this product hydrates without leaving any residue and does not cause any irritation or rash. This is the only "hyaluronic acid serum" i will use on my skin. Please never discontinue this product. Sincerely, A Cerave lover.

I have dry skin in the summer, and very dry skin in the winter. No matter how much water i drink or how gentle the products i use, my cheeks get easily chapped, and i live in Texas ya'll. It does not cold where I'm at lol. When my skin isnt flairing up i do use actives as well as tret once per week. I use this every night over my cetaphil moisturizer and wake up with no more chapped cheeks. Well, almost every night. Sometimes I forget to do my skincare and notice a big difference.
